URL, URLSearchParams and History API

URL parses and constructs URLs; URLSearchParams manages query parameters with encoding. History API
pushState changes same-origin session history without reloading; popstate observes history traversal.

Interview question: Does pushState trigger popstate immediately?
Answer: No. popstate typically fires when traversing history, such as browser back/forward.
